turns.prompt: How do goal cycles work today, and is anything on the Roadmap going to change that?

args.line: The blueprint says goal cycles reset weekly; Roadmap card #2569 plans to count sessions instead.

replies.text:
**Today a goal cycle starts when a tutor sets a goal on the student card and resets every week.** Tutors review progress in the session wrap-up at the end of each cycle, per the [Goal Setting](https://blueprint.example/cell/goal-setting) cell.

The Roadmap has one change planned: [Goal cycle resets per session](https://www.notion.so/example-2569) (Need PRD) would count cycles by sessions attended. I read both just now.
